title: 上海高考翻译背诵-90-24一模

items.zh: 参观这家博物馆能带你回到20世纪30年代。
items.en: Visiting this museum can bring you back to the 1930s.

items.zh: 新软件能够以超出预期的速度处理数据。
items.en: The new software is capable of processing data at the speed beyond expectations.

items.zh: 超市离我家步行就能到达，买日用品非常方便。
items.en: As the supermarket is within walking distance from my home, it is convenient for me to buy groceries.

items.zh: 他之所以能成为一名家喻户晓的体育明星,不仅仅是因为他在赛场上酣畅淋漓的表现,更是因为的努力和谦虚。
items.en: What makes him a household sports star is not only his brilliant performance, but also his hard work and modesty.
